children: TechPrecision entered into an amendment to its existing revolving credit facility with Beacon Bank & Trust, extending the maturity from September 15, 2026 to October 16, 2026. The $4.5 million revolver, held by subsidiary Ranor and affiliates, remains in place under existing terms aside from the new maturity date. The short extension is intended to preserve liquidity while the company evaluates next steps for renewal or refinancing.

: Provide short-term extension pending renewal or refinancing
